% A bibliography whose \bibliographystyle and \bibliography are in a file
% read by \include, which writes both to that file's .aux, with citations
% in the text, in italic, in a footnote, in a theorem, and in a heading.
\documentclass{article}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\begin{document}
\section{Parts after~\cite{baker}}
A citation~\cite{able}, and one in italic: \emph{as~\cite{baker} shows}.\footnote{A footnote citing~\cite{able}.}
\begin{theorem}[\cite{baker}]
A theorem citing~\cite{able}.
\end{theorem}
\include{test-bibinclude/refs}
\end{document}
